surface_mechanism_description: The Cl extraction reaction occurs probably following Eley–Rideal mechanism, which is relatively insensitive to growth temperature.
evidence: For comparison, more halogen contamination (2.5%) has been reported for Ta films grown by PE-CVD using TaBr and hydrogen plasma at a higher growth temperature (T s 450 8C) w13x. Previous report of Ti PE-ALD has shown that the Cl extraction reaction occurs probably following Eley–Rideal mechanism w16x, which is relatively insensitive to growth temperature. Analogous to the previous report on Ti PE-ALD, the Cl extraction reaction during Ta PE-ALD can be represented by the following equation, TaCl (a)q + 5H(g)™ Ta(a)q + 5HCl(≠) ( 1)
